description.value: This study examined prosocial giving and its behavioral and structural neural correlates in patients with bvFTD, patients with AD, and healthy controls using the Giving Game and voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: This study found evidence that prosocial behavior, as assessed by a novel computer‐based task of prosocial giving, is impaired in bvFTD compared to healthy controls.

value: we hypothesized that prosocial giving would be compromised in bvFTD compared to healthy controls and patients with Alzheimer's disease (AD)
we hypothesized that atrophy in brain structures that support reward processing would be associated with alterations in prosocial giving
